card.name: Linking words in lab test interference
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, for, as, a, positive) in label text about drug effects on lab or screening tests, just before the test or result is named.

modes.label: False-positive results
modes.description: The word positive or for inside a false-positive urine screen statement.
modes.example: CONTRAVE can cause false-<< positive>> urine test results for amphetamines.

modes.label: Confirmatory tests
modes.description: The word as in 'such as' before a confirmatory method like chromatography.
modes.example: Confirmatory tests, such<< as>> gas chromatography/mass spectrometry

modes.label: Test procedure wording
modes.description: A linking word before the measured item in a diagnostic procedure or detection statement.
modes.example: Blood is drawn<< for>> plasma cortisol determination at 8:0

card.writes: It pushes toward odd name-like pieces and away from the word check or checking.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in sentences about how a drug can affect lab or screening test results.
